tool_args.rationale: The observations support a saturating response to u_now and a decreasing response to s_grad. Numerically fitted smooth candidate forms are selected by leave-one-out error, then submitted for fresh confirmation at the observed target horizon. Dependence on the invariant state variables and other horizons remains unidentified.

considered_alternatives.option: Bilinear mass action and gradient-independent Beverton–Holt recruitment
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot saturates with u_now, and the open-branch observations show a substantial gradient effect.
Both informative probe types have already been acquired; the nuisance measurement is irrelevant. The available observations support testing a smooth gradient-modulated transfer model directly.
All observations have the same horizon and other state variables, so their independent dynamical effects cannot be identified from these data.
